housing_subtitle: Hanuuninta markaad raadineyso guri dabaq ah iyo sharciga kireysiga
find_housing_subtitle: Sideen ku heli karaa guryo gudaha Austria?
finding_preparation_subtitle: Ka hor inta aan la raadin
finding_preparation_ads_desc: Isticmaal xayaysiisyada guryaha ee wargeysyada iyo goobaha internetka (tusaale Willhaben, WG-Gesucht, kooxaha Facebook).
finding_preparation_budget_desc: Kirada (oo ay ku jiraan kharashyo dheeraad ah) waa inay ahaadaan ugu badnaan saddex meelood meel dakhligaaga.
finding_preparation_costs_desc: Fadlan ogow kharashyada dheeraadka ah sida deebaajiga iyo guddiga dilaaliinta ee suurtogalka ah.
finding_viewing_subtitle: Waxa ay tahay inaad fiiro gaar ah u yeelato
finding_viewing_check_desc: U fiirso iftiinka, qaabka qolka iyo xaaladda guriga (daaqadaha, albaabada, kuleylka).
finding_viewing_lift_desc: Hubi in uu jiro wiish (sababka sare)
finding_viewing_prep_desc: U diyaari su'aalaha oo u soo bandhig wakhtiga iyo si habsami leh.
registration_meldezettel_subtitle: Foomka diiwaangelintu waa foom lagu diiwaangelinayo ciwaanka deegaankaaga.
registration_meldezettel_what_desc: Foomka diiwaangelinta ciwaanka aad degan tahay Awstaria.
registration_meldezettel_how: Tani waa sida ay u shaqeyso
registration_meldezettel_how_desc: Buuxi foomka → Calaamadaha mulkiilaha → U gudbi xafiiska degmada ama garsooraha.
registration_meldezettel_deadline_desc: Wax aan ka dambayn 3 maalmood kadib soo guurista.
cost_subtitle: Kiro, deebaaji iyo kharashyo dheeraad ah
cost_deposit_desc: Bixinta amniga (badanaa kirada 2-3 bilood).Waa laguu soo celin doonaa markaad ka guurto haddii gurigu xaaladiisu wanaagsan tahay.
cost_utilities_desc: Kharashyada dheeraadka ah sida kharashyada hawlgalka, kulaylinta, korontada iyo internetka.
contract_definition_desc: Heshiis ka dhexeeya kiraystaha iyo kireeyaha.Waxay nidaamisaa muddada iyo kharashyada.
contract_important_desc: Cinwaanka, qaddarka kirada, deebaajiga, muddada heshiiska, muddada ogeysiiska.
contract_refund_desc: Xaq u lahaanshaha soo celinta deebaajiga (haddii aanay waxyeelo soo gaadhin).
everyday_rules_house_desc: Fadlan ogow waqtiyada nasashada iyo xeerarka qoyska.
everyday_garbage_split_desc: Si gooni gooni ah u tuur waraaqaha, organic, caagagga iyo qashinka haraaga ah.
everyday_utils_reg_desc: Korontada iyo internetka inta badan waa in laga diiwaan geliyo bixiyaha laftaadu.
